description: Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka - Notice under Section 10(3) of the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2003 (Amended) Issuance of Certificate of Exemption
categorisation: This gazette content is a legal notice issued by the Public Utilities Commission of Sri Lanka under the Sri Lanka Electricity Act, No. 20 of 2009 (amended). It concerns the issuance of a Certificate of Exemption from licensing requirements for electricity distribution and supply. This falls squarely under the definition of Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it pertains to regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and the application of a specific act of parliament.
